user.title: Set up HomaGotchi
user.description: HomaGotchi will monitor Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) spam attacks and FlipperZero devices.

init.title: HomaGotchi Options
init.description: Configure detection sensitivity and auto-reset behavior

data_description.intensity_threshold: Number of suspicious BLE events required within the time window to trigger detection
data_description.intensity_window: Time window in seconds for counting suspicious BLE events
data_description.auto_reset_timeout: Time in seconds before sensors auto-reset if no new detections occur
data_description.flipper_intensity_threshold: Number of FlipperZero detections required within the time window to trigger alert
data_description.flipper_intensity_window: Time window in seconds for counting FlipperZero detections
